Run the chainmail daemon

## Usage

```text
chainmail daemon [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
# production runs under systemd; a development daemon runs as you
chainmail daemon --dev --config ./config.toml --state-dir ./state --vault-key-file ./vault-key
```

## Flags

```text
      --config string           config file (default $CHAINMAIL_CONFIG, then /etc/chainmail/config.toml) (default "/etc/chainmail/config.toml")
      --dev                     development mode: run as yourself with a non-production state directory (default $CHAINMAIL_DEV)
      --state-dir string        directory for vault.age, state.db and, unless [cache] dir is set, cache.db (default $CHAINMAIL_STATE_DIR, then /var/lib/chainmail) (default "/var/lib/chainmail")
      --vault-key-file string   age identity file (default $CHAINMAIL_VAULT_KEY_FILE, then $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY/vault-key)
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
